chapter_note: Pure cosmological substrate teaching: enumeration of the eight places where Living Fire exists. Heavy manuscript damage (78%) but the visible structure is clearly the Persian-style numbered correspondential map (First/Second/Third/Sixth/Seventh/Eighth). Cosmic figures: Father/God of Truth, First Man, Perfect Man, Call and Hearing, Omophorus, New Land, First Woman, ship of day, luminary of night. Only one editorial intrusion: the apostolic frame at i=3. The 'new land' triggered an ecclesial false-positive on ⲃⲣⲡⲉ but the referent here is cosmic, not the church. Editorial fatigue is negative — substrate density INCREASES through the chapter, confirming the teaching dominance.
